title: Three and four A particles at rest, symmetric layouts: the P-0027 pair table summed pairwise predicts positions to 0.007 (T <= 2)

claims.statement: Three or four A particles, all at rest, every initial pairwise distance in [5.0, 7.1], observed for at most T = 2.0: each particle accelerates toward each other particle with magnitude K(r)/r^2.5, where K(r) is the piecewise-linear P-0027 table and r the current separation; the accelerations add (no three-body term); walls reflect elastically. Measured positions are predicted to a judged RMSE of 0.007 of the chamber side. Evidence is one equilateral triangle (side 6.0, T = 2.0) and one square (side 5.0, diagonal 7.07, T = 1.5), both symmetric and both tracker-only. A single global factor fitted to both runs is 0.996 +/- 0.004. Not claimed: N = 2 (covered by P-0027), N >= 5 (P-0028 covers the N = 8 ring), asymmetric N = 3 or 4 layouts, species other than A, initial velocities, durations above 2.0, or pair separations outside [5.0, 7.1].
